verdict.rationale: Gusto documents business formation (LLC formation, EIN registration, bank account) and ongoing state compliance filings. The pack has no evidence of founder stock purchase agreements, IP assignment documents, or 83(b) election preparation or filing. Because Gusto now offers formation, post-incorporation setup is a fair question to ask of it, but formation and compliance filing are adjacent features that do not deliver this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can complete post-incorporation setup — founder stock purchases, IP assignment, and 83(b) elections — with correct standard paperwork
